description: Functional spec: Bridge.fetch_any_channel_config/1 and capability_snapshot must distinguish no connector from multiple same-provider connectors; do not synthesize capability for ambiguity. Owner Channels.Bridge; reuse ChannelConfig.list_by_provider (active/nonarchived) rather than new Action. Test first: missing still synthetic, disabled sole works, two same-provider fail with :ambiguous_connector for fetch and snapshot; no adapter invocation. Branch/paths: lib/zaq/channels/bridge.ex and test/zaq/channels/bridge_test.exs. Mocking: existing adapter stubs only at provider boundary. Docs: existing channels service already says ambiguous fails closed; no change anticipated. Validate isolated test and mix q, then separate draft PR atop #802. Retain parent zaq-emb.21 for wider audit.
title: [zaq-emb.24] Reject ambiguous connector capability lookup
